overall_goal: Clean the kitchen utensils, serve food, and tidy up the workspace

goals.description: Wipe the tabletop and prepare the sponge to clean the first batch of utensils
goals.rationale: The person wipes the tabletop and then applies dishwashing liquid to a sponge to clean a spatula.

goals.description: Clean the first batch of utensils with the sponge
goals.rationale: The person uses the soapy sponge to scrub a cup, milk frother, frying pan, and chopping board.

goals.description: Rinse and place the first batch of utensils in the crockery tray
goals.rationale: The person washes the scrubbed chopping board, milk frother, spatula, cup, and frying pan under running water and places them in the tray.

goals.description: Clean the second batch of utensils with the sponge
goals.rationale: The person uses the sponge to scrub a glass, spoon, knife, bowls, spoons, and a cup.

goals.description: Rinse and place the second batch of utensils in the crockery tray
goals.rationale: The person washes the scrubbed bowls, spoons, cup, glass, and knife under running water and places them in the tray.

goals.description: Wipe the tabletop, clean the sink area, and wash hands
goals.rationale: The person wipes the tabletop, cleans the sink area with the sponge, and washes their hands with dishwashing liquid.

goals.description: Put away the milk frother and dry hands
goals.rationale: The person places the milk frother in its stand and then dries their hands with a tablecloth.
The person pours ketchup onto a plate with a bread omelette and then stores the ketchup bottle in the cabinet.

goals.description: Add milk to the coffee and mix
goals.rationale: The person pours milk from a carton into a cup and mixes the coffee with a spoon.

goals.description: Wipe the tabletop and store the milk in the refrigerator
goals.rationale: The person wipes the tabletop with a tablecloth and then places the milk carton in the refrigerator.

goals.description: Prepare the pressure cooker for washing
goals.rationale: The person moves the pressure cooker to the sink and pours dishwashing liquid into it.
